title: Boundary-optimized closures for diagonal-norm upwind SBP operators
summary: By employing non-equispaced grid points near boundaries, boundary-optimized upwind finite-difference operators of orders up to nine are developed. The boundary closures are constructed within a diagonal-norm summation-by-parts (SBP) framework, ensuring linear stability on piecewise curvilinear multiblock grids. For linear problems, this stability is inherited from the diagonal norm SBP framework provided the approximation satisfies the metric identities (i.e. it is free-stream preserving).
